description.value: Riva is a waterfront restaurant on Sidney's Beacon Avenue offering stunning harbour views alongside a fresh seasonal menu of local seafood, flatbreads, burgers, and house-made desserts. The kitchen sources ingredients locally whenever possible and accommodates gluten-free diners across most of the menu. Regular live jazz performances by acclaimed musicians make it a lively evening destination as well as a daytime dining stop.
